newsitem.title: UK: Metroline climbs to premium on LSE debut.
newsitem.headline: Metroline climbs to premium on LSE debut.

text.p: Shares in London bus company Metroline Plc on Tuesday jumped to an eight percent premium on their first day of dealings on the London Stock Exchange, dealers said.
Metroline shares, issued at 173p, climbed 14-1/2p to 187-1/2p by 0856 GMT in volume of 300,000 shares.
The company, which was formed from a management and employee buy-out from London transport in 1994, operates bus routes in north-west and central London.
Metroline made pre-tax profits of three million in the year to October 31 1996 and said it would make not less than four million stg in the current fiscal year.
The company was capitalised at 37.2 million stg at its issue price.
